preconditions.description: The number of points n is an integer between 1 and 30 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= 10**9 and 0 <= y <= 10**9 for (x, y) in points)
preconditions.description: All output coordinates must be integers within the range [0, 10^9].
All n points output by the program must be distinct.

preconditions.expression: all(color in ['black', 'white'] for color in colors)
preconditions.description: The interactor responds to each point with either 'black' or 'white'.

postconditions.description: The program outputs exactly n points before the final line.
The two points defining the separating line must be distinct.
The coordinates of the separating line points must be within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: all((x1 - x2) * (py - y1) - (y1 - y2) * (px - x1) != 0 for (px, py) in points)
postconditions.description: No point lies on the separating line defined by (x1, y1) and (x2, y2).

postconditions.expression: all(((x1 - x2) * (py - y1) - (y1 - y2) * (px - x1)) * ((x1 - x2) * (py2 - y1) - (y1 - y2) * (px2 - x1)) > 0 for (px, py) in points if colors[points.index((px, py))] == 'black' for (px2, py2) in points if colors[points.index((px2, py2))] == 'white')
postconditions.description: All black points lie on one side of the line and all white points lie on the other side.
